import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesMultiplication
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModulesPrincipalization
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ModulesIsoOnBasis
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.AffineOpenStalkLocalization

/-!
# Tensor multiplication for divisor modules

The canonical rational-function multiplication identifies
`O(D) tensor O(E)` with `O(D + E)`. Locally a principal equation for `D`
reduces the section map to the tensor unitor. This supplies divisor addition
for the Cartier-ideal twists in Kleiman's relative effective-divisor route.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverModule overModule divisorSectionsModule

variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
  [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- On an open where the first divisor is principal, multiplication of
divisor sections is an isomorphism of tensor products. -/
theorem divisorModulesMulApp_bijective_of_principalization
    (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (q : X.functionFieldˣ) {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : (U : Set X).Nonempty)
    (hq : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz D) :
    Function.Bijective (divisorModulesMulApp K D E U) := by
  have hD : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz (D - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz 0 := by
    intro z hz hzU
    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, hq z hz hzU, sub_self, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero]
  have hDE : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz (D + E - divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz E := by
    intro z hz hzU
    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, hq z hz hzU]
    exact add_sub_cancel_left _ _
  let eD : Γ(divisorModules K D, U) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(X, U) :=
    (divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K D 0 q U hD).trans
      (divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K U)
  let eDE := divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K (D + E) E q U hDE
  let eR := (TensorProduct.congr eD
    (LinearEquiv.refl Γ(X, U) Γ(divisorModules K E, U))).trans
      (TensorProduct.lid Γ(X, U) Γ(divisorModules K E, U))
  have hg (s : Γ(divisorModules K D, U)) :
      (X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU)).hom
        (eD s) = (q : X.functionField) * divisorVal K s :=
    (germ_divisorModulesZeroSectionsEquiv K hU _).trans
      (divisorVal_divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K D 0 q hU hD s)
  have hcomm : ∀ a, eDE (divisorModulesMulApp K D E U a) = eR a := by
    intro a
    induction a using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero =>
      exact ((congrArg eDE (divisorModulesMulApp K D E U).hom.map_zero).trans
        eDE.map_zero).trans eR.map_zero.symm
    | add a b ha hb =>
      exact ((congrArg eDE ((divisorModulesMulApp K D E U).hom.map_add a b)).trans
        (eDE.map_add _ _)).trans
          ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) ha hb).trans (eR.map_add a b).symm)
    | tmul s t =>
      apply divisorSection_ext K
      change divisorVal K (eDE (divisorSectionsProduct K s t)) =
        divisorVal K (QcohOn.qsmul (F := X.divisorSheaf K E) le_rfl (eD s) t)
      rw [divisorVal_divisorModulesSectionsMulEquiv K (D + E) E q hU hDE,
        divisorVal_divisorSectionsProduct,
        divisorVal_qsmul K (genericPoint_mem_of_nonempty hU), hg, mul_assoc]
  constructor
  · intro a b hab
    apply eR.injective
    rw [← hcomm, ← hcomm, hab]
  · intro b
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := eR.surjective (eDE b)
    exact ⟨a, eDE.injective ((hcomm a).trans ha)⟩

/-- On an affine principalizing open, the actual sheaf multiplication is
an isomorphism on sections. -/
theorem divisorModulesMul_isIso_app_of_principalization
    (D E : X.CurveDivisor) (q : X.functionFieldˣ) {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hne : (U : Set X).Nonempty)
    (hq : ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz D) :
    IsIso ((divisorModulesMul K D E).val.app (op U)) := by
  haveI := Modules.tensorSectionHom_isIso (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) hU
  haveI : IsIso (divisorModulesMulApp K D E U) := by
    rw [ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective]
    exact divisorModulesMulApp_bijective_of_principalization K D E q hne hq
  haveI : IsIso (Modules.tensorSectionHom (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) U ≫
      (divisorModulesMul K D E).val.app (op U)) := by
    rw [tensorSectionHom_comp_divisorModulesMul]
    infer_instance
  exact IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left
    (Modules.tensorSectionHom (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) U) _

/-- Canonical multiplication of divisor modules is an isomorphism. -/
theorem divisorModulesMul_isIso (D E : X.CurveDivisor) :
    IsIso (divisorModulesMul K D E) := by
  let B := {U : X.Opens // IsAffineOpen U ∧ (U : Set X).Nonempty ∧
    ∃ q : X.functionFieldˣ, ∀ (z : X) (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X), z ∈ U →
      coeffAt hz (divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) q) = coeffAt hz D}
  have hB : Opens.IsBasis (Set.range (fun U : B => U.val)) := by
    apply Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mpr
    intro W x hxW
    obtain ⟨q, V, hxV, -, hq⟩ := exists_affineOpen_eq_divOf K D x
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hxU, hUV⟩ :=
      exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset (show x ∈ W ⊓ V from ⟨hxW, hxV⟩)
    refine ⟨U, ⟨⟨U, hU, ⟨x, hxU⟩, q, ?_⟩, rfl⟩, hxU,
      le_trans hUV inf_le_left⟩
    intro z hz hzU
    exact hq z hz (hUV hzU).2
  apply Modules.isIso_of_isIso_app_basis (divisorModulesMul K D E)
    (fun U : B => U.val) hB
  intro U
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := U.property.2.2
  exact divisorModulesMul_isIso_app_of_principalization K D E q
    U.property.1 U.property.2.1 hq

/-- The canonical tensor-addition isomorphism for divisor modules. -/
noncomputable def divisorModulesTensorIso (D E : X.CurveDivisor) :
    Modules.tensorObj (divisorModules K D) (divisorModules K E) ≅
      divisorModules K (D + E) :=
  letI := divisorModulesMul_isIso K D E
  asIso (divisorModulesMul K D E)

@[simp]
lemma divisorModulesTensorIso_hom (D E : X.CurveDivisor) :
    (divisorModulesTensorIso K D E).hom = divisorModulesMul K D E := rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
